aria: Animated recap of the Suns' 128 to 107 win over the Kings: Devin Booker's backdoor layup with 5:22 left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Dillon Brooks' season-high 29 points, the top scorers, how the Suns won, and Friday's game in Utah.
notes: Box score from the Suns' 128–107 win over the Sacramento Kings at Golden 1 Center on Nov 18, 2026, from the Covers box score and team stats, checked against theScore's line score, with game details from the Associated Press (via WRAL and Yahoo Sports), Bright Side of the Sun (via Yahoo Sports), NBC Sports Bay Area, Arizona Sports and z93jamz. All 128 Phoenix points and all 107 Sacramento points are accounted for in the Covers player lines, and the quarter scores add up to both totals: Phoenix 36–31 after one, 65–60 at the half, 99–84 after three. Team stats (points in the paint 60–42, also in AP; assists 34–29; field goals 48 of 84 to 41 of 88; free throws 17 of 22 to 11 of 15; offensive rebounds 7–11; biggest leads Phoenix 27, Sacramento 2) are from Covers. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Wednesday's games.

The Kings cut it to 55–52 late in the second quarter before Phoenix answered with a 10–0 run; Sacramento closed the half on an 8–0 run to trail 65–60 (Bright Side of the Sun). Phoenix won the third 34–24 (AP), including 12 straight points from 80–74 to 92–74 (z93jamz). Sacramento opened the fourth with six straight points to get within nine before a smaller Phoenix lineup pushed the lead back up (Arizona Sports; NBC Sports Bay Area). Brooks' 29 were his best of the season (z93jamz; Arizona Sports). Rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 36 for Sacramento (box score). The Suns are at .500 for the first time this season and have won six of eight (AP; Bright Side of the Sun). The Kings have lost seven straight and are 1–13, tied with the 1990–91 team for the worst start in franchise history (AP). Phoenix plays at Utah on Friday (AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Devin Booker's backdoor layup off a pass from Miles Bridges that made it 115–96 with 5:22 left (Bright Side of the Sun gives the pass, the score and the clock). It is drawn as the template's short finish near the rim, not the exact cut. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Phoenix Suns or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Booker's listed 6-foot-5 and 206 pounds (Wikipedia), with his arms scaled to the 6-foot-8¼ wingspan measured at the 2015 NBA Draft Combine (theScore), in the Suns' road colors with No. 15, the number he switched to this season (SLAM). His look is the proposed one on file. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
